fields.label: Available Memory Mb
fields.help: Memory (in MB), available to the function.

fields.label: Build Service Account
fields.help: The fully-qualified name of the service account to be used for the build step of deploying this function

fields.label: Build Worker Pool
fields.help: Name of the Cloud Build Custom Worker Pool that should be used to build the function.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: Description of the function.

fields.label: Docker Registry
fields.help: Docker Registry to use for storing the function's Docker images.

fields.label: Docker Repository
fields.help: User managed repository created in Artifact Registry optionally with a customer managed encryption key.

fields.label: Entry Point
fields.help: Name of the function that will be executed when the Google Cloud Function is triggered.

fields.label: Https Trigger Security Level
fields.help: The security level for the function.

fields.label: Https Trigger URL
fields.help: URL which triggers function execution.

fields.label: Ingress Settings
fields.help: String value that controls what traffic can reach the function.

fields.label: KMS Key Name
fields.help: Resource name of a KMS crypto key (managed by the user) used to encrypt/decrypt function resources.

fields.label: Max Instances
fields.help: The limit on the maximum number of function instances that may coexist at a given time.

fields.label: Min Instances
fields.help: The limit on the minimum number of function instances that may coexist at a given time.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A user-defined name of the function.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: Project of the function.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region of function.

fields.label: Runtime
fields.help: The runtime in which the function is going to run.

fields.label: Service Account Email
fields.help: If provided, the self-provided service account to run the function with.

fields.label: Source Archive Bucket
fields.help: The GCS bucket containing the zip archive which contains the function.

fields.label: Source Archive Object
fields.help: The source archive object (file) in archive bucket.

fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: Timeout (in seconds) for the function.

fields.label: Trigger Http
fields.help: Boolean variable.

fields.label: VPC Connector
fields.help: The VPC Network Connector that this cloud function can connect to.

fields.label: VPC Connector Egress Settings
fields.help: The egress settings for the connector, controlling what traffic is diverted through it.

fields.label: Automatic Update Policy
fields.help: Security patches are applied automatically to the runtime without requiring the function to be redeployed.

fields.label: Event Trigger
Event Type
fields.help: The type of event to observe.

fields.label: Resource
fields.help: The name or partial URI of the resource from which to observe events.

fields.label: Failure Policy
Retry
fields.help: Whether the function should be retried on failure.
Specifies policy for failed executions
A source that fires events in response to a condition in another service.

fields.label: On Deploy Update Policy
fields.help: Security patches are only applied when a function is redeployed.

fields.label: Secret Environment Variables
Key
fields.help: Name of the environment variable.

fields.label: Project ID
fields.help: Project identifier (due to a known limitation, only project number is supported by this field) of the project that contains the secret.

fields.label: Secret
fields.help: ID of the secret in secret manager (not the full resource name).

fields.label: Version
fields.help: Version of the secret (version number or the string "latest").
Secret environment variables configuration

fields.label: Secret Volumes
Mount Path
fields.help: The path within the container to mount the secret volume.

fields.label: Project ID
fields.help: Project identifier (due to a known limitation, only project number is supported by this field) of the project that contains the secret.

fields.label: Secret
fields.help: ID of the secret in secret manager (not the full resource name).

fields.label: Versions
Path
fields.help: Relative path of the file under the mount path where the secret value for this version will be fetched and made available.

fields.label: Version
fields.help: Version of the secret (version number or the string "latest").
List of secret versions to mount for this secret.
Secret volumes configuration.

fields.label: Source Repository
URL
fields.help: The URL pointing to the hosted repository where the function is defined.
Represents parameters related to source repository where a function is hosted.
